workerResult.summary: Emberline Islet Cartography — a japanese-cyberpunk hex-map sandbox (13x9 pointy-top grid). Drag 島/海 brushes to raise/sink islands, tap 灯 to stake up to 6 lantern-beacons that claim land within 2 sails, Dijkstra trade winds auto-route between beacons preferring open water with animated neon dashes, and ⛩ export renders a 1200x880 washi postcard PNG with manifest, signature and hanko stamp. First run seeds a drifting archipelago with 2 beacons + live route; autosaves to localStorage; works from file://. Palette is exactly 3 inks (ember, lagoon, gold) + black/white. Headless harness verified boot, 4 animation frames, stats (25 land / 2 beacons / 1 route) and persistence with zero errors.
